record_title: Cumulant effective-trial hierarchy for Poisson-binomial laws
provenance: A sharp hierarchy connecting third- and fourth-cumulant effective trial counts for sums of independent Bernoulli variables, with exact finite-trial moment envelopes and equality cases.
limitations: Requires independent Bernoulli summands; gives necessary low-moment constraints rather than a full cumulant-feasibility characterization; no optimal Berry--Esseen constant is claimed; an older formula-level equivalent may remain in uninspected Bernoulli-sum moment literature.
